Responsabilidades Gerenciar e expandir o território designado Desenvolver novas contas e oportunidades de negócio Fortalecer relacionamento com médicos, hospitais e KOLs Promover, vender e oferecer suporte técnico aos produtos Acompanhar procedimentos médicos e demonstrar diferenciais técnicos Apoiar negociações, contratos e processos de licitação Trabalhar em conjunto com especialistas de produto em treinamentos Garantir padronização e presença dos produtos no mercado Representar a empresa em eventos e congressos Qualificações Ensino superior completo (Enfermagem, Engenharia, Ciências da Saúde, Marketing ou áreas correlatas) Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em vendas no mercado médico Conhecimento em hemodinâmica, cath lab e rotinas hospitalares Experiência com licitações públicas será um diferencial Inglês avançado desejável Habilidades Necessárias Perfil "hunter", proativo, orientado a resultados e com forte atuação em campo Experiência sólida em vendas de dispositivos médicos (preferencialmente em hemodinâmica) Vivência em desenvolvimento de território e abertura de contas Excelente capacidade de relacionamento e influência Autonomia, organização e visão estratégica Experiência com licitações públicas será um diferencial Disponibilidade para viagens: aproximadamente 50% do tempo Por que se juntar à Terumo? Na Terumo, trabalhamos com propósito: contribuir para a sociedade por meio da saúde. Esta é uma oportunidade de atuar em um desafio estratégico, com autonomia e impacto real na vida de pacientes, ampliando o acesso a soluções inovadoras em regiões com grande potencial de crescimento. Se você busca crescimento, desafio e propósito, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Analista de controladoria sr
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de controladoria sr em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades: Elaborar e consolidar o orçamento anual da área comercial, bem como prestar suporte na elaboração do orçamento das áreas de Administração de Vendas, Trading, Merchandising e/ou Marketing. Conduzir mensalmente o processo de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast), interagindo com as áreas internas para entendimento dos desvios e proposição de ações corretivas e preventivas. Elaborar e atualizar o Forecast, garantindo acuracidade, consistência dos drivers e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio. Executar e manter as rotinas de pricing da Empresa, assegurando coerência entre custos, margens, impostos, políticas comerciais e estratégia competitiva. Analisar dados de vendas, custos, margens e preços vigentes, recomendando ajustes de preço com base em rentabilidade, elasticidade, posicionamento de mercado e sustentabilidade financeira. Realizar estudos de precificação de novos produtos, considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, benchmark de mercado e impacto no portfólio. Analisar a rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal, recomendando ações para melhoria de margem e mix. Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI). Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros. Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado. Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas. Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias. Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado. Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas. Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato. Requisitos: Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA. Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados. Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado. Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal. Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas. Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais. Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio. Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro. Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão. Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação. Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados. Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação). Aviso Legal: Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis. Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência. Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Senior rust engineer (relocation to munich)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior rust engineer (relocation to munich) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Rust Engineer Low Latency | Async Rust | Tokio Salary: 90,000 - 105,000 On-site | Munich We have a new and exclusive partnership with one of the most exciting scale-ups in Europe, who are looking to double in size their engineering team. They have a valuation exceeding 2 billion Euros. The company builds aerial intelligence hardware and software. They're main focus is the manufacturing of UAV's. Alongside this, they are also developing bleeding edge software that provides actionable insights in defense, security and professional services. The Rust Team: This engineering team are focusing on building a greenfield command and control center, designed specifically for unmanned systems. What you'll be doing: Architect, build, and support reliable, high-performance systems for coordinating swarms and handling sensor data. Develop streamlined communication methods and real-time data processing tools tailored for robotic platforms. Work hand-in-hand with multidisciplinary teams to connect backend infrastructure with robotic applications and sensor arrays. Enhance overall system efficiency, expandability, and dependability within distributed robotic setups. Experience you'll need: Production experience with Rust, or contributions to production grade open source repos. 2+ Years. Experience working with Tokio, or other asynchronous frameworks such as async.std or Smol. Ideally a background in a core programming language such as C, C++, or Core Java. Candidates from functional backgrounds such as Scala, Erlang or Clojure are also encouraged to apply. Experience developing low-latency, high throughput systems. Nice to have: Experience working with drones or robotics experience working with microcontrollers This is an excellent opportunity to join one of the most rapidly scaling companies in Europe, that are developing truly cutting edge software and hardware.

Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas. Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias. Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado. Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas. Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato. Requisitos: Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados. Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado. Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal. Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas. Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência. Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Data engineer iii
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data engineer iii em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Posição temporária! Visão Geral da Posição A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização. O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio. O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA. O que você fará Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis. Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes. Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados. Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas. Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos. Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização. Qualificações Mínimas • Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada. • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas. • Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente). • Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / Py Spark). • Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados. • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines. • Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake). • Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados. • Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento. • Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos. • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. • Inglês fluente. Qualificações Desejáveis • Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos. • Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning. • Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots). • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA. • Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence). • Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

title: Almoxarife i
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Almoxarife i em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades: Atender às reservas e requisições de materiais, separando e entregando conforme necessidade das áreas internas. Receber materiais conferindo AR (Autorização de Recebimento) e condições físicas dos produtos. Armazenar os materiais em locais apropriados, respeitando critérios de segurança, validade e acessibilidade. Realizar contagens cíclicas e apoiar na execução de inventários físicos. Controlar prazos de validade e integridade dos materiais durante o armazenamento. Apoiar na organização e limpeza do almoxarifado, conforme padrões de 5 S. Lançar movimentações básicas no sistema ERP, com apoio ou sob orientação do Almoxarife II ou do líder. Comunicar divergências ou anomalias nos materiais ou processos ao superior imediato. Apoiar em outras atividades do setor sempre que necessário. Realizar descargas, e movimentações dentro do almoxarifado com o uso de empilhadeira. Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato. Requisitos: Ensino médio Completo. Habilitação em Empilhadeira (NR 11). Carteira de Habilitação B. Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA. Experiência atuando em almoxarifado. Vivência no pacote office, principalmente Excel; Conhecimento em procedimentos de recebimento, conferência e controle de estoque, em sistema ERP (movimentações, baixas, requisições) e em inventário físico e contagem cíclica. Aviso Legal: Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis. Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência. Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ What You'll Be Responsible For • Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM • Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials • Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person • Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date • Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track • Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed • Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ What We're Looking For Experience • 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role • Experience working with Saa S platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus • Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement Skills • Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily • Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly • Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users • Highly organized with strong attention to detail • Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift Mindset • You follow through. Every time. • You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated • You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients • You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Tools You'll Work With VEXOS platform (proprietary) · Notion or Asana · Zoom · Google Workspace · Loom ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ What We Offer • Competitive salary in USD • 100% remote — work from Brazil or Mexico • Direct day-to-day collaboration with the founder • A stable, long-term role in a growing company • Opportunity to grow into greater responsibility as VEXOS scales ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ How to Apply Send your CV and a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) covering: 1. Who you are and what you've managed 2. Why this role interests you 3. One example of how you handled a difficult client situation Applications without the Loom video will not be reviewed. Apply via DM or email: #hiring #remotejobs #vexos #therenderpos #proptech #projectmanager #clientsuccess #remotework #Brazil #Mexico #latinamerica

title: Cloud engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and Dev Ops processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (Ia C). Primary Job Duties: Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time. Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work. Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues. Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision. Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design. Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures. Support Dev Ops practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues. Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices. Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings. Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis. Improve system reliability through automation and observability. Qualifications Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role. Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration. Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS. Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools. Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required. Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role. Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot, Chat GPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity. AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Sys Ops Administrator, or Developer. Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems. Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly. Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position. This is a CLT role and not open to PJ. Compensation is R$9000-R$12000/month plus bonus

title: Specialist ai engineer / builder (llm & healthcare) | remote job
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist ai engineer / builder (llm & healthcare) | remote job em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI. We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale. Why This Role Might Be for You Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn. You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate. Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build. Key Responsibilities Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities. Today: Execution and Precision Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance. Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable. Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously. Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases. Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer. Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage. What We're Looking For Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required. Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company. Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as Open AI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock. Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact. What We Offer Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture. High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI. Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful. Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil. Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us. Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company's story.

title: Maintenance manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Maintenance manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Morgan Latif is an executive search and development consultancy focused on outcome-driven leadership hiring. We partner with organisations across Medical Technology & Healthcare, Packaging, Chemicals & Speciality Materials, Consumer, and Industrial Technology to secure leaders who create measurable impact and long-term business performance. Through deep sector expertise, rigorous assessment, and alignment to business objectives, we identify individuals who not only fit the role, but perform strongly and thrive within the organisation. _________________________________________________ Job Title: Maintenance Manager Company: Multi-national Mood Manufacturer Position is based in Valencia, Spain and relocation would be supported should your application be successful. We are working with a fast paced, Private-Equity backed, Food Manufacturing business who is seeking someone with a strong drive for process optimization, CMMS implementation, and leading a maintenance team of approximately 20 people. The role will involve leading and coordinating maintenance activities for a 24/7 continuous-process plant, managing and optimizing maintenance for process equipment, and driving the transition from reactive to proactive, reliability-based maintenance, including preventative and predictive strategies. Fluency in both English and Spanish is essential for this role. Candidate Profile: Fluent English & Spanish speaker Strong experience in process industries (mandatory), such as food, or paper manufacturing. Proven background in reliability-focused maintenance within environments where maintenance strategies are already mature. Ability to implement and sustain best practices in preventive and predictive maintenance. High level of safety awareness, especially in energy-intensive and high-risk environments. High level of Quality awareness linked with Food industry Strong leadership and soft skills to drive cultural change and build trust and accountability. Experience managing complex maintenance organizations and driving data-driven decision-making. Comfortable working with new equipment and establishing KPIs (e.g., MTBF still to be defined due to new machinery). KPI: Asset reliability / up time (OEE improvement) Reduction of unplanned downtime Preventive vs reactive maintenance ratio Safety, food safety & compliance Maintenance cost vs downtime cost optimization If you feel up to for a challenge and thrive in a dynamic environment, we look forward to receiving your application!

title: Ai evaluation engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai evaluation engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About First Ignite First Ignite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production. The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at First Ignite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company. What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the Open AI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests. Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Open AI Evals, Deep Eval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results. Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, Lang Graph, Open AI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs. Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy. As part of your Linked In application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you're proud of. Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

title: Psiquiatra
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Psiquiatra em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. VAGA PARA MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA — ATENDIMENTO ONLINEA Dr Psiq está em expansão e busca médicos(as) psiquiatras comprometidos(as), éticos(as) e responsáveis para atuação em telemedicina, realizando atendimentos psiquiátricos por vídeo em nossa plataforma digital. Buscamos profissionais que compreendam que a psiquiatria vai além da capacidade técnica: valorizamos médicos humanizados, pontuais, comprometidos com seus pacientes e responsáveis com os horários e agendas disponibilizados. Principais atividades Realização de consultas psiquiátricas por vídeo; Avaliação diagnóstica e acompanhamento terapêutico; Elaboração de planos terapêuticos individualizados; Atendimento de adolescentes, adultos e idosos; Evolução em prontuário eletrônico; Emissão e assinatura digital de documentos médicos; Participação no cuidado contínuo e promoção da saúde mental dos pacientes. Requisitos obrigatórios
Graduação em Medicina; CRM ativo e regular; Formação em Psiquiatria através de: Residência Médica com RQE ativo; ou Pós-graduação em Psiquiatria reconhecida; Experiência em atendimento psiquiátrico; Boa comunicação e postura ética; Comprometimento com agendas e horários disponibilizados para atendimento; Possuir certificado digital válido (e-CPF ou equivalente) para inserção na plataforma e assinatura eletrônica de documentos médicos. Documentação obrigatóriaO profissional deverá apresentar: Currículo atualizado; Documento de identificação profissional; CRM ativo; Certidão de regularidade do Conselho Regional de Medicina; Comprovante de quitação da anuidade do CRM; Certidão ético-profissional emitida pelo CRM; Documentação comprobatória da especialização em Psiquiatria; RQE (quando aplicável); Certificado digital válido para utilização na plataforma. Processo seletivoApós análise curricular e documental, o profissional passará por entrevista de habilitação junto à equipe da clínica para avaliação do perfil profissional, disponibilidade e alinhamento com o modelo de atendimento da instituição. Toda a documentação deverá ser encaminhada para o e-mail: Após o envio da documentação, o candidato deverá entrar em contato com o suporte da clínica através do Whats App: informando o interesse na vaga para que seja direcionado(a) ao setor responsável pelo processo de habilitação profissional. Diferenciais Experiência em psiquiatria da infância e adolescência; Conhecimentos em psicofarmacologia e neurociência; Formação complementar em psicoterapia; Fluência em outros idiomas; Disponibilidade para educação continuada. Modelo de atuação
Atendimento 100% online; Plataforma própria de teleconsulta fornecida pela clínica; Flexibilidade de agenda; Remuneração por percentual das consultas realizadas; Parte do valor da consulta destinada à clínica e parte repassada ao profissional. A clínica prioriza profissionais organizados e comprometidos com o funcionamento operacional dos atendimentos. Por isso, é indispensável que o médico: Mantenha disponibilidade regular no Whats App para comunicação com a equipe da clínica; Acompanhe frequentemente a plataforma e o site para verificar consultas agendadas; Responda aos chamados administrativos e assistenciais dentro de prazo razoável; Cumpra impreterivelmente os horários e agendas disponibilizados para atendimento. O que esperamos do profissionalMais do que títulos e currículo, buscamos médicos comprometidos com: Responsabilidade profissional; Pontualidade e organização; Cumprimento rigoroso das agendas; Respeito aos pacientes; Ética e humanização no atendimento; Continuidade e qualidade assistencial.

title: Business analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else. When you join us, you will have: Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family. As a business analyst, you will join a client service team and take ownership of a workstream to solve some of the toughest challenges our clients face. And these aren’t just any clients—they're some of the most influential organizations around, from Fortune 500 giants to innovative startups. We will expect you to go the extra mile, delivering solutions that solve immediate problems and drive long-term change. And we’ll rely on your judgment and integrity to ensure our recommendations are effective and long-lasting. You will take on a role that goes beyond advising. You’ll be at the heart of the action—helping to uncover the true challenges behind a client’s strategy and creating actionable plans that drive real change. Working alongside clients and other Mc Kinsey colleagues, you’ll combine research, analyzing data, interviews, and brainstorming to generate fresh insights and breakthrough solutions. Your commitment to our values will be crucial in earning our clients' trust and delivering results that matter. As you collaborate directly with clients, you’ll help them solve problems, refine strategies, and implement transformations. By equipping them with the tools and knowledge to continue innovating and improving after we’ve left, you’ll ensure the impact of our work endures. In doing so, you’ll uphold Mc Kinsey’s commitment to making a meaningful difference in the industries and communities we serve. Typically, an undergraduate degree with less than 4 years of work experience; Requirements may vary by country or practice. Excellent organization capabilities, including the ability to initiate tasks independently and see them through to completion. Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and local office language(s), with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels. Proficient in rational decision making based on data, facts, and logical reasoning. Ability to create work product-focused materials / outputs, which may include Power Point decks, Excel models, articles, or other written deliverables. Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment. Ability to work or attend meetings outside of traditional business hours or take on projects with limited or no notice at times. Ability to travel to and work in varying environments that may be challenging and/or not accessible (e.g., factories, hospitals, mines).

Ser referência técnica interna: apoiar decisões complexas, destravar discussões e reduzir retrabalho. System design básico aplicado: rate limit, circuit breaker, bulkhead e degradação graciosa. Concorrência e integridade: locks e consistência (otimista/pessimista). Ser referência técnica interna: apoiar decisões complexas, destravar discussões e reduzir retrabalho. Mensageria e resiliência (Bull MQ/Rabbit MQ): retry, DLQ, idempotência e ordering quando necessário. Performance e escalabilidade: profiling, gargalos comuns e trade-offs. System design básico aplicado: rate limit, circuit breaker, bulkhead e degradação graciosa. Concorrência e integridade: locks e consistência (otimista/pessimista). title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing ai agent builder em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview: As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA. Core Responsibilities: • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time. • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI. • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention. • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards. • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM. Qualifications & Skills: • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine. • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, ) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI). • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output. • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company's internal knowledge base. • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de desenvolvimento de software iii em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a fintech do Grupo Energisa, que há mais de 120 anos leva energia de qualidade a milhões de brasileiros e impulsiona o desenvolvimento do país. Aqui na Voltz, nosso propósito é acelerar a inclusão digital e financeira de clientes em todo o Brasil. Desde 2021, construímos soluções inovadoras que atendem todo o ecossistema do Grupo Energisa, empresa, clientes e fornecedores. Atuamos como um hub de produtos financeiros escaláveis, geradores de valor e focados em transformar a experiência de quem utiliza serviços essenciais. Estamos em constante evolução e buscamos pessoas que queiram construir o futuro com a gente, com inovação, tecnologia, impacto real e foco no cliente. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Ser o owner técnico de um domínio ou subsistema, garantindo evolução segura e saudável ao longo do tempo. Garantir que o domínio opere com SLOs acordados (latência/erros/disponibilidade) e trabalhar ativamente para melhorar a confiabilidade. Liderar planejamento técnico e execução do domínio: decomposição, dependências, riscos, execução e validação. Elevar consistentemente o nível técnico do time: boas práticas, revisão forte, referências, documentação e padrões. Ser referência técnica interna: apoiar decisões complexas, destravar discussões e reduzir retrabalho. Liderar resposta a incidentes do seu domínio: mitigação, RCA rigoroso e ações preventivas estruturais. Requisitos e qualificações: Type Script + Node.js (async/await, promises, error handling; event loop, streams e concorrência). Desenvolvimento de APIs REST com Open API (contratos, validação e status codes). SQL (Postgres): consultas, migrations, otimização de queries e índices. Git e fluxo de PRs (commits pequenos, rebase e resolução simples de conflitos). Testes automatizados (unitários, integração e contrato) com Jest. CI/CD e deploy: pipeline (lint/test/build/deploy), smoke tests, variáveis e logs. Observabilidade: logs estruturados, métricas básicas e tracing superficial. Mensageria e resiliência (Bull MQ/Rabbit MQ): retry, DLQ, idempotência e ordering quando necessário. Performance e escalabilidade: profiling, gargalos comuns e trade-offs. System design básico aplicado: rate limit, circuit breaker, bulkhead e degradação graciosa. Concorrência e integridade: locks e consistência (otimista/pessimista). Noções de No SQL e cache (TTL e riscos de inconsistência). Gestão de incidentes: mitigação, RCA/post-mortem e ações preventivas. Informações adicionais: Vale alimentação ou Refeição para fazer as compras para sua casa ou comer no seu restaurante preferido; Plano de saúde e odontológico para você e sua família; Previdência privada para sua reserva financeira e investimentos; Seguro de Vida, para dar mais tranquilidade a você e a quem você ama; Participação nos lucros, como incentivo pelo seu trabalho e resultados; Programas de qualidade de vida que garantem o bem-estar e promovem a saúde dos nossos colaboradores; Wellhub que te dá acesso a mais de 18 mil academias no Brasil. Se você possui os pré requisitos da vaga, faça sua candidatura e fique atento nas dicas: - Durante a jornada do processo de seleção, a comunicação será via e-mail ou por telefone. - Certifique que seus dados estão atualizados e fique de olho na sua caixa. de e-mail, sem esquecer da caixa de spam. - Fique atento nas ligações, os nossos telefones corporativos possuem variação de DDD. Caso receba um feedback negativo, não desanime, fique atento a outras oportunidades.

Confira esta oportunidade para Senior golang engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a global leader in the meal kit delivery industry that helps millions of customers cook healthy, homemade meals without the stress of meal planning or grocery shopping. As part of Zoolatech's distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery. By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity. Responsibilities Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture Skills Required Strong commercial experience with Golang Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, Rabbit MQ, or AWS SQS/SNS Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing Strong knowledge of relational databases Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills Good communication skills and ability to work independently English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams Nice to Have Experience with Python Familiarity with Mongo DB, Elasticsearch, Graph QL, or JVM languages Experience working in fast-paced MVP or startup-like environments Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully) This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider. To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country. Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: U.s. immigration paralegal/case manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para U.s. immigration paralegal/case manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description Robinson Immigration Law is a boutique U. S. immigration law firm based in Nashville, Tennessee, serving clients across the United States and globally with 100% remote capability. The firm focuses on high-skill, business, and investment-based immigration, working with founders, executives, researchers, creatives, and investors looking to build their lives and careers in the U. S. via pathways such as the EB-1 A, EB-2 NIW, O-1 A, and E-2. We prioritize thoughtful positioning and effective solutions to achieve durable immigration outcomes. Role Description This is a full-time, remote role for an Immigration Case Manager (Paralegal), with a focus on visas including the EB-1 A, EB-2 NIW, O-1, and E-2. The case manager will assist in immigration case preparation, including communicating with clients, performing legal research, drafting support letters, and completing immigration forms. Responsibilities include working with clients to gather necessary documents, providing updates on case status, and maintaining accurate and organized electronic filing systems. The role also involves calendaring deadlines, ensuring timely submissions, and collaborating directly with attorneys to ensure a smooth and efficient case process. Qualifications Experience with EB-1 A, EB-2 NIW, O-1, or E-2 visas Strong legal research, case management, and document preparation skills Experience in drafting professional correspondence and support letters Excellent organizational, time management, and attention-to-detail capabilities Well-developed communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact professionally with clients Proficiency in legal or office software systems and tools Ability to work independently in a remote environment and manage multiple tasks or deadlines What we offer Supportive and collaborative team environment Competitive salary and vacation policy Opportunities for learning and advancement Fully remote work environment A real seat at the table on a small, high-performing team Work that matters. Every petition you help file is someone's career, family reunification, or major life transition. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assessor de investimentos em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da geral: Estamos em busca de um(a) Profissional Financeiro com certificação CPA-10 ou CPA-20 para atuar no suporte e atendimento a clientes, análise de perfil de investidor, e distribuição de produtos financeiros. O(a) profissional ideal tem perfil analítico, boa comunicação e experiência no setor bancário ou de investimentos. Responsabilidades: Prestar atendimento e suporte técnico/consultivo a clientes pessoa física e jurídica; Realizar análises de perfil de investidor (suitability) e apoiar na recomendação de produtos financeiros; Comercializar produtos como CDB, LCI/LCA, fundos de investimento, previdência, entre outros; Apoiar a área comercial no processo de prospecção e fidelização de clientes; Atualizar cadastros, monitorar prazos e garantir conformidade com as normas da ANBIMA e do BACEN; Acompanhar indicadores e relatórios de desempenho da carteira de investimentos. Requisitos: Certificação CPA-10 ou CPA-20 (obrigatória); Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras, cooperativas de crédito ou corretoras; Conhecimento em produtos bancários e investimentos; Facilidade com sistemas bancários, Excel e plataformas de investimento; Boa comunicação, proatividade e foco em resultados. Diferenciais: Certificações adicionais (CEA, CFP, ANCORD); Vivência com atendimento consultivo em agências bancárias ou mesas de investimentos; Domínio de ferramentas como Smarkia, BLK, ou plataformas de investimentos digitais. Benefícios: Salário compatível com o mercado Participação nos lucros (PLR) Vale-refeição e alimentação Plano de saúde e odontológico Previdência privada Programa de desenvolvimento e capacitação contínua

title: Paid ads qa auditor - global
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Paid ads qa auditor - global em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss? Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look? Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems? Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away? If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA role. At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry. Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients' brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously. This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent. This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error. However, it is not a "task-ing" role, or a role where you'll be constantly told what to do - you'll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems. ** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY ** You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions: Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first. Then reply to the ad, stating you've completed the Willo, and we will be in touch. Key Responsibilities Include: Campaign Audit & Validation Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, Linked In, Tik Tok, streaming platforms, and others Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity Identify discrepancies such as: Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations Inconsistent implementation across platforms Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup Budget & Pacing Verification Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly Tracking, Links & Technical QA Verify accuracy and functionality of: URLs and landing pages UTM parameters and tracking links Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable) Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation Compare campaign execution against: Internal strategy direction Client Success Manager requests Campaign updates or pivots Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely Audit Documentation & Communication Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error) Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution Audit Operations (Evolving Scope) This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including: Audit Cadence: Pre-launch validation Post-launch verification Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits Audit Coverage: Full account audits Targeted sampling across accounts Audit Depth: Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links) Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy) Ownership Scope: Identifying and flagging discrepancies Recommending corrective actions Supporting enforcement of quality standards Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must: Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments Have strong written communication skills Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment Preferred Experience: Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking) Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.) Nice to Have: Salesforce or CRM familiarity Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards Experience documenting processes or building SOPs Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required): Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Google Tag Manager (GTM) Tik Tok Ads Linked In Ads Trade Desk Why Our Work Matters: Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn't teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn't enough. That's where Crisp comes in. We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it's a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors. Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably. About Crisp: Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U. S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022). Crisp () is the nation's fastest-growing law firm growth company. We've helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue. Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal. OUR BOOK: The Game Changing Attorney (available on Amazon and Barnes & Noble) OUR PODCAST: The Game Changing Attorney Podcast Why You Should Work Here: You will work inside a structured, high-performance marketing operation You will contribute to campaigns running at scale across hundreds of accounts You will play a direct role in improving execution accuracy and system reliability You will be trusted to identify and surface critical issues This is not a role for someone looking for easy work or vague expectations. This is a role for someone who takes pride in enforcing standards, identifying errors, and ensuring systems operate correctly. ** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY ** You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions: Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first. Then reply to the ad, stating you've completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.

title: Senior outsystems engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior outsystems engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Out Systems Engineer About the Role We are seeking a Senior Out Systems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution. This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance. What You'll Do Stabilize and Modernize Architecture Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows Optimize Database and System Performance Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health Build a Real Release Pipeline Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline Configure deployment automation using Out Systems APIs Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities Remove unused or redundant components Define governance for capacity-impacting changes Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes Map data entities into portable schemas Capture business logic embedded within the platform Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows What You Bring Required Experience 5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale Out Systems applications Deep experience with Out Systems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within Out Systems Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments Preferred Experience Experience supporting or leading Out Systems to custom platform migrations Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling Experience with license optimization and application object management Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems Working Environment Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

NET - Pleno, para atuar em parceria com o maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina, especializado em capital de investimento, de risco, além de gerenciamento de patrimônio e ativos globais. Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we're not just building products, we're pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world's most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that's just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you're passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We've grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes: New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry. Performance - all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth. Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base. Responsibilities Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including: New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies. Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth. Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools. Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc. Requirements With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend. Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture. Comfortable with high-availability concepts. Highly proficient in Java Script and ES6+. Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these. Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via Node JS, with Mongo DB, configuring ports and local environment Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools. Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs. Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life. Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: Verify the recruiter's identity. All our recruiters have verified Linked In profiles. If you're unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over Whats App, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending   or@ We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

capabilities • Bonus: Experience with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval systems • Bonus: Experience building multi-step agent workflows • Bonus: You actively build AI projects outside of work • Bonus: You use AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow
